items.title: AstraZeneca (LSE:AZN) Reports Positive TEZSPIRE Phase 3 Results, Is The Discount Too Wide?
items.summary: Amgen and AstraZeneca (LSE:AZN) reported positive top line Phase 3 results for TEZSPIRE in eosinophilic esophagitis, with clinically meaningful improvements through week 52. That kind of readout often prompts investors to revisit AstraZeneca stock. Even with a steady stream of late stage trial updates around TEZSPIRE, Tagrisso combinations and Enhertu, AstraZeneca’s share price has drifted, with a year to date share price return down 10.87% at £121.14.
